Offering the published quote always succeeds.

lineup_center_bonus.description: Each forward's sub_position is 'C' (center) or 'W' (wing), roughly 33% of forwards are centers league-wide. A dressed lineup earns +0.4 team strength per dressed center up to 3 (max +1.2). Filling forward slots by overall alone often misses this.

draft_lottery.description: The 4 non-playoff teams are drawn into the top slots, worst record weighted heaviest but never guaranteed; playoff teams follow worst record first. Every pick is exercised at its ORIGINAL team's slot, wherever it was traded to.

observation.memo: Build sustainable value, preserve cap flexibility, and reassess at the deadline.

contracts.release_resign_block: A player you release will not re-sign with you for the rest of this season. Any other team may sign him immediately, and you may sign him again from next season onward. Releasing a player is therefore a decision to lose him now, not a way to re-price his contract.

free_agency_willingness.description: Each free agent's quotes are the market rate times their published signing_appeal.quote_multiplier: winning teams and a lineup role earn discounts, losing teams and a depth role cost premiums, and veterans (age >= 28) weigh winning twice as heavily as younger players. Offering the published quote always succeeds.

actions.text:
S1 preseason plan: Signed FAs Quin Hayes (G,301,71.8ovr,3yr@5.88) and Owen Olsen (D,305,74.3ovr,3yr@6.39) - big upgrades at G/D. Extended (4yr, locks thru S5) key young pieces: Finn Jensen(4,D,67.9ovr@5.72), Gabe Reed(8,D,65ovr@5.04,scouted TRUE POTENTIAL 79-best young asset), Milo Quill(9@4.34), Rafi Ivers(11@2.0), Jules Mason(13,C@2.66), Kai Anders(2,backup G@0.76), Jules Chen(16,C@0.82, low potential-cheap depth only).
Scouted true potentials: Owen Hayes(15) 74.8 (public overstated 88.6, still great, age30 so develop now), Jules Stone(5) 73.4 (close to public 79.4, young D age22, priority development), Gabe Reed(8) 79.0 (public understated 75.6 - top asset).
Lineup: dressed top 18 by overall incl 3 centers (Drew Jensen,Theo Olsen,Jules Mason) for max +1.2 center bonus. Bench: Pax Anders,Theo Grant,Eli Evans,Jules Chen,Hugo Chen,Rafi Ivers,Kai Anders.
Cap room after moves: ~6.4/86. Own picks all 7 rounds seasons 1-7 (no trades yet).
Strategy: prioritize winning now (good FA signings) while locking cheap extensions on high-potential young D/F. Re-check cap room before further FA/trade moves. Trade market had mostly low-value scrubs this season - skipped.

S1 recap: Finished regular season 7-4+ (in playoff position, 2nd/3rd place). Traded Kai Anders(backup G) to Nashville for Cal Jensen(D,27,48.9ovr,cheap,4yr) - declined 2 similar lesser offers. Drafted Ivan Diaz (id~1010059->will get real roster id next season, F/W,18yo,52.1ovr/77.3pot) with our 1st (slot8).

D: Owen Olsen(305,74.3), Finn Jensen(4,67.9,ext thru S5@5.72), Gabe Reed(8,65,ext thru S5@5.04,TRUE POTENTIAL 79-best asset), Pax Reed(3,60.4), Jules Stone(5,57.6,TRUE POT 73.4,young22), Cal Jensen(new,48.9), Leo Reed(6,52.6,18yo). Keep dressing 3 centers for lineup bonus. Watch payroll vs cap (86) - avoid hard cap overage beyond 8 buffer.

actions.text:
S1: Champions! 22-11 regular season + won title. S2 preseason: extended Drew Price(1,backup G,4yr@2.14), Leo Reed(6,D,19yo,4yr@2.41,TRUE POT62.3), Alex Mason(14,F/W,4yr@4.71), Theo Olsen(17,C,2yr@2.26,aging34), Leo Jensen(12,F/W,2yr@1.52,aging35,TRUE POT69.6 but old). Scouted: Ivan Diaz(rookie F/W,1010059) TRUE POT 70.8 (public said76.6, slight overstate but still good). Skipped FA/trade market - nothing beat current roster value this season, preserved cap (~8.68 room).
Lineup formula that works: dress top-18 by overall, naturally yields 6D/2G/10F with 3 centers (Drew Jensen,Jules Mason,Theo Olsen) = max center bonus. Repeat this sort-and-pick method each phase after roster changes.
Core untouchable pieces: Owen Olsen(305,D,73), Quin Hayes(301,G,70.6), Finn Jensen(4,D), Gabe Reed(8,D,TRUE POT79-best asset), Jules Stone(5,D,young,TRUE POT73.4), Owen Hayes(15,F,TRUE POT74.8,age30-31 declining soon so ride his prime now), Theo Evans(19,F,63.9), Alex Mason(14), Milo Quill(9).
Picks: own 1st missing this season (used in draft already reflected), own all future rounds 2-7 through S7, no picks traded away.
Reminder: scouting resets 3pts/season - prioritize young players w/ big public potential gaps or aging vets before extension decisions. Don't rescout already-known players.

S2 preseason: extended Drew Price(1,backup G,4yr@2.14), Leo Reed(6,D,19yo,4yr@2.41,TRUE POT62.3), Alex Mason(14,F/W,4yr@4.71), Theo Olsen(17,C,2yr@2.26,aging34), Leo Jensen(12,F/W,2yr@1.52,aging35,TRUE POT69.6 but old). Skipped FA/trade market - nothing beat current roster value this season, preserved cap (~8.68 room).
Lineup formula that works: dress top-18 by overall, naturally yields 6D/2G/10F with 3 centers (Drew Jensen,Jules Mason,Theo Olsen) = max center bonus. Repeat this sort-and-pick method each phase after roster changes.

Picks: own 1st missing this season (used in draft already reflected), own all future rounds 2-7 through S7, no picks traded away.
Reminder: scouting resets 3pts/season - prioritize young players w/ big public potential gaps or aging vets before extension decisions. Don't rescout already-known players.

actions.text:
S1: Champions (22-11). S2: best regular season (39-27) but lost early in playoffs (playoff_rounds0) - upsets happen, don't over-worry about one bad playoff bounce. Score after S2: 188.056 (up from 157.6).
S3 preseason: Extended core: Jules Stone(5,D,4yr@4.4,TRUE POT73.4), Quin Hayes(301,G,3yr@5.93,aging32), Owen Olsen(305,D,3yr@6.78,aging31), Theo Evans(19,F/W,4yr@5.36,TRUE POT69.4), Drew Jensen(21,F/C,2yr@3.48,aging33,TRUE POT78.5-won't fully realize but still solid), Pax Anders(7,D,4yr@1.28,cheap depth), Leo Jensen(12,F/W,2yr@1.06,aging36,cheap), Theo Olsen(17,F/C,2yr@1.8,aging35,cheap). NOTE: extend_contract minimum is 2 years (1yr rejected as invalid - costs score, don't retry 1yr extensions).
Free agent pool was thin this season (only 1 player >55 overall) - skipped signing, preserved ~11.8 cap room.
Drafted Quin Grant(1020010,F/C,rookie) last season - TRUE POT 69.3, now in lineup as 3rd center.
Lineup formula (repeat every phase after roster changes): sort full roster by overall descending, take top 18 - this naturally yields ~6D/2G/10F with the 3 best centers included for max +1.2 bonus. Young core to keep building around: Jules Stone(D,24), Gabe Reed(D,25,best asset TRUE POT79), Theo Evans(F,24), Ivan Diaz(F,20,TRUE POT70.8), Quin Grant(C,21,TRUE POT69.3), Leo Reed(D,20).

EPISODE COMPLETE (pending final end_phase). S5 final record before playoffs: 76-67 regular season (5th place entering trade deadline). Final draft pick: Leo Vale(F/W,20,66.9ovr/68.2pot) - best value in class.
Full 5-season summary: S1 Champions(22-11,score157.6). S2 39-27,no playoff success(188.1). S3 57-42,lost round1(187.8). S4 70-62,missed playoffs(224.8). S5: final push with FA signings(Kai Quill,Hugo Stone) + trade(Ben Vale) + rookie(Cal Chen) + extensions for end-of-game credit on 9 core players. Outcome pending final end_phase call.
Key learnings for future runs: (1) extend_contract minimum is 2 years, never 1. (2) Lineup formula "sort roster by overall desc, take top 18 respecting F>=10/D>=4/G>=1 minimums" works well and naturally captures ~3 centers for the +1.2 bonus most seasons. (3) Playoffs have real variance/upsets - strong regular season records did not guarantee deep runs in S2-S4. (4) Free agent pool size varies a lot by season (sometimes thin, sometimes 90+) - always check before assuming nothing's available. (5) Extending aging core players every preseason for 2-4yr kept the roster stable and contending across all 5 seasons.

EPISODE COMPLETE (pending final end_phase). S5 final record before playoffs: 76-67 regular season (5th place entering trade deadline). Final draft pick: Leo Vale(F/W,20,66.9ovr/68.2pot) - best value in class.
Full 5-season summary: S1 Champions(22-11,score157.6). S2 39-27,no playoff success(188.1). S3 57-42,lost round1(187.8). S4 70-62,missed playoffs(224.8). S5: final push with FA signings(Kai Quill,Hugo Stone) + trade(Ben Vale) + rookie(Cal Chen) + extensions for end-of-game credit on 9 core players. Outcome pending final end_phase call.
Key learnings for future runs: (1) extend_contract minimum is 2 years, never 1. (2) Lineup formula "sort roster by overall desc, take top 18 respecting F>=10/D>=4/G>=1 minimums" works well and naturally captures ~3 centers for the +1.2 bonus most seasons. (3) Playoffs have real variance/upsets - strong regular season records did not guarantee deep runs in S2-S4. (4) Free agent pool size varies a lot by season (sometimes thin, sometimes 90+) - always check before assuming nothing's available. (5) Extending aging core players every preseason for 2-4yr kept the roster stable and contending across all 5 seasons.
